answer: Require each agent to lock a slashable quartz bond and obtain one signed voucher from an already-verified peer before it may vote. Influence grows with the square root of stake, so splitting capital among Sybil nodes buys no extra power, yet every fake node still needs its own bond and voucher. A gale of bots thus multiplies cost without multiplying reward, while the crystal chain of vouchers lets auditors trace any cluster back to a few real backers and slash their collateral.
